synopsis: SimMining-3D (2024) is a mining-specific synthetic lidar dataset developed because sensor-height and viewpoint changes on mine benches degrade 3D detection [f7036, f14464, f16085]. It varies sensor height to address this viewpoint domain shift in mining 3D detection [f7063, f16085]. Chapter 9 and the glossary consistently describe this motivation and approach, but the supplied facts provide no quantitative detection results or evidence of how much the dataset reduces the degradation [f7036, f7063, f12819, f14464, f16085].
